unresolved_leads.title: Permissive CSV row-loss on current DuckDB versions (issue #19880 family)
unresolved_leads.evidence_state: Reported on DuckDB 1.4.1 (2025-11-21): read_csv_auto(ignore_errors=true) dropped 12,094/99,999 valid rows that strict mode reads [S4/S7]. Issue closed with no captured maintainer fix comment; only comment is the reporter requesting deletion after uploading proprietary data [S8]. No evidence establishes whether any release fixes it.
unresolved_leads.design_response: Default ingestion path never uses skip-on-error; strict full-column scan + quarantine is mandatory before any permissive read (proposal §5, §14).
unresolved_leads.next_step: Verify behavior on the pinned engine version during implementation (proposed check PU-W6); re-check duckdb issue tracker before release.

unresolved_leads.title: DVC docs repository ownership moved (iterative/dvc.org -> treeverse/dvc.org observed in GitHub API redirect)
unresolved_leads.evidence_state: Contents API for iterative/dvc.org served repository URL api.github.com/repositories/135934107 = treeverse/dvc.org [S2 capture context]. Docs content still resolves via the same path.
unresolved_leads.design_response: Cite DVC docs by content sha256, not by branch; treat DVC as an exported format target, not a runtime dependency (proposal §2.2).
unresolved_leads.next_step: None for the design; citation-hygiene note only.

unresolved_leads.title: Cross-machine numerical determinism
unresolved_leads.evidence_state: DVC's own guidance avoids hardware-dependent code in reproducible stages [S2]; bit-level float equality across BLAS/CPU variants is not established by any captured source.
unresolved_leads.design_response: Replay guarantee is scoped to deterministic re-execution against pinned inputs/env, not bitwise equality; comparisons use normalized-content hashes (proposal §6).
unresolved_leads.next_step: During validation, measure float-result hash stability across two machines (PU-W5 extension).

unresolved_leads.title: DuckDB cross-process concurrency semantics
unresolved_leads.evidence_state: Concurrency documentation page exists in the captured docs navigation (duckdb.org/docs/current/connect/concurrency) but its content was NOT captured; no source fact on multi-process write behavior.
unresolved_leads.design_response: Architecture already avoids sharing one DuckDB database file across processes (per-kernel in-process engine; files as interchange; single-writer flock per project) (proposal §3, §10).
unresolved_leads.next_step: Capture and read the concurrency page before implementing any shared-file shortcut.

unresolved_leads.title: pylock.toml installer/tool support in current pip/uv
unresolved_leads.evidence_state: PEP 751 is Final and names pylock.toml [S9], and its banner says the canonical spec moved to the PyPA specs page; which installers consume it today was not established in this research.
unresolved_leads.design_response: pylock.toml is the binding format; fallback is a fully-hashed requirements export (proposal §14).
unresolved_leads.next_step: Check PyPA pylock.toml spec page + pip/uv release notes at implementation time.

unresolved_leads.title: Whether DuckDB #11740-class error-path inconsistencies (conversion error despite ignore_errors=true with rejects_table, 0.10.2) were fully fixed
unresolved_leads.evidence_state: Issue recorded as closed in the search capture [S4]; no fix PR for #11740 specifically was traced (PR #14417 fixes #14393, a related-but-distinct sniffer/rejects issue).
unresolved_leads.design_response: Reinforces strict-default design; permissive path is opt-in with rejects tables (proposal §5).
unresolved_leads.next_step: Optional: trace #11740 closure link if the SQL console exposes rejects_table workflows.

optional_opportunities.title: Parquet as universal interchange with the SQL colleague
optional_opportunities.rationale: DuckDB reads/writes Parquet natively [S3 engine family]; content-hashed derived tables make sharing drift-resistant. Validation deferred to PU-W5.

optional_opportunities.title: nbdime-style rich output diffing
optional_opportunities.rationale: Hash-diff of tabular outputs is in scope now; media-aware diffing deferred (proposal §6).

optional_opportunities.title: Real-time collaboration, hosted service, scheduling, extra language kernels
optional_opportunities.rationale: Explicitly optional per brief §15; rejected for minimum scope; SQL need is met by the embedded engine, not a second kernel (proposal §7).

rejected_alternatives.title: Import blacklist as isolation
rejected_alternatives.reason: Does not constrain the interpreter; our own execution receipt describes kernel isolation as supplied by Bubblewrap/systemd, not code filters [W1 limitations]; brief §13 forbids promising it.

rejected_alternatives.title: requirements.txt as environment binding
rejected_alternatives.reason: PEP 751 motivation documents it as non-standard, opt-in-hash, not installer-independent [S9].

rejected_alternatives.title: DVC as the core project format
rejected_alternatives.reason: Git/CLI-centric, interactive-notebook-poor fit; retained as export target [proposal §2.2/§11].

rejected_alternatives.title: pandas+sqlite engine
rejected_alternatives.reason: Loses typed columnar scans, rejects tables, and the 5 GB streaming path; kept as bounded fallback [proposal §11, §14].
